summary: Backend-only test pass covering 4 new surfaces: quote duplicate, quote PDF export, step-photo email, and competitor scraper Cloudflare posture. 18/18 tests passed (100%). Schemas + auth guards verified. Resend sandbox rejects test@example.com — accepted per playbook (backend log 'Resend send failed' confirmed the endpoint reached Resend). No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: When Resend rejects the send, backend raises HTTPException(502) with a JSON detail. In practice the Kubernetes ingress/Cloudflare returns its own 502 HTML page before the FastAPI JSON body reaches the client. Consumers therefore cannot rely on r.json()['detail'] to distinguish provider errors from infra outages. Consider returning 200 with {ok:false, error:...} or 422 so the ingress does not swallow the payload.

Endpoint completed in 0.4s with match_count=0 and error=None — suggests result was served from cache OR Playwright returned an empty page without recording an error. Schema is fine, but ok=false with error=null offers no actionable signal to the admin UI. Consider surfacing 'no matches (empty listing)' vs 'browser render failed' as distinct errors.

action_items: Optional: rework 502 provider-error responses so the JSON detail survives the ingress (see minor issue #1) — either drop to 200 with envelope or add explicit Retry-After + smaller body.
Optional: enrich competitor /test response so ok=false includes a distinguishable error class (empty vs blocked vs render-failed).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/quotes.py duplicate_quote: legacy-inputs fallback silently drops unknown keys — acceptable but log a warning so ops can spot schema drift.

routes/orders/steps.py email_step_photos: manufacturer 403 check uses order['manufacturer_id']; if that key is None (unassigned orders) the equality check with user['id'] will pass through as 200. Consider explicit None guard.

routes/competitors.py: hardcoded canned_criteria in test_competitor endpoint (natural 1ct Round). If admin adds a bespoke site tailored to a different segment, false negatives are likely — expose criteria as query params.
seed_data_creation: Created two freelance quotes (piece_description prefixed TEST_) via /api/quotes/freelance for duplicate + pdf tests. No persistent test-only orders/emails created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use test_iter16_features.py as-is. It self-loads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env and accepts both 200 and 502 for the Resend send path (checking backend.err.log for 'Resend send failed'). Auth endpoint returns {access_token, ...} not {token}. Admin order-list endpoint is /api/orders (role-stripped, no steps) — must fetch individual orders via /api/orders/{id} to inspect steps/photos. Seed mfg (mfg@somnio.co) owns SMN-2026-105, so 403 test rotates through shanghai/shenzhen/guangzhou@somnio.co.
rca_of_issue: n/a — no bugs to RCA. Two friction points hit during test authoring: (1) Login response uses 'access_token' not 'token'. (2) /api/orders list is role-stripped so per-order fetch is required to see steps + photos. Fixture handles both.
